continuity: One Annihilation can annihilate multiple Level 100-plus elite undead at once, though Jin regards it as a double-edged spear.
Jin now possesses the Title One Against a Thousand and the Intimidation stat; the Title enhances his battlefield performance, reduces fatigue consumption, frightens enemies, and boosts allied morale.
The Arch Lich's Familiar Link has been forcibly severed, its ten empowered guards have been destroyed, and it has suffered backlash from their loss.
The surviving monster army is intimidated and disorganized while the more than two hundred members of Jin's suicide squad advance as a unified force.
The Arch Lich suspects that Jin may be the ancient human Adversary who defeated it in the past.
plot: Jin Taekyung uses One Annihilation to erase ten Darkened Death Knights and Liches, countless elite monsters, and the Arch Lich's observing Familiars. The attack grants him four Level Ups, massive EXP and Fame, the Title One Against a Thousand, and the new Intimidation stat. Its effects terrify the surviving monsters and greatly raise the suicide squad's morale, allowing more than two hundred fighters to charge through the breach. The Arch Lich's Familiar Link is severed and its ten empowered guards are destroyed, leaving it injured and wondering whether Jin may be the ancient Adversary who defeated it long ago.
translation_decisions: Render 일기당천 as One Against a Thousand.
Render 마계어 as Demon Realm language.
Preserve Jin's dry, profane, game-like voice in the Jin-shelin joke and his battlefield commands.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is leading more than two hundred suicide-squad members through the Arch Lich's battlefield toward Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing.
Jin's One Annihilation erased ten Darkened Death Knights and Liches, countless elite monsters, and the Arch Lich's observing Familiars.
Jin gained four Levels, massive EXP and Fame, the Title One Against a Thousand, and the new Intimidation stat.
One Against a Thousand enhances Jin's performance against multiple enemies, reduces fatigue consumption, intimidates enemies, and raises allied morale.
The suicide squad used the breach created by One Annihilation to resume its advance as a unified force.
The Arch Lich's Familiar Link was severed, its ten empowered guards were destroyed, and the resulting backlash injured it.
The Arch Lich suspects Jin may be the ancient human Adversary who defeated it in the past.
open_questions: Is Jin the ancient human Adversary remembered by the Arch Lich?
What was the Arch Lich's former identity, and what became of the king it once served?
Can Jin and the suicide squad reach Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing after exploiting the breakthrough?

Render 마계어 as Demon Realm language.

profile_creations.personality: Calculating, arrogant, vindictive, and wary of humans because of its painful defeat in the distant past.
profile_creations.relationships: The Arch Lich empowered Lei Fei as a Death Knight Lord, commands the battlefield's elite undead, and now suspects Jin Taekyung may be the ancient Adversary who defeated it.
profile_creations.role: The Arch Lich is an undead ruler who commands a monster army, empowers elite retainers with its own mana, and observes the battlefield through Familiars.
profile_creations.voice: Cold and contemptuous in thought, with terse telepathic commands and judgmental internal commentary.
